canonicalization.hash: sha256 of canonical bytes lowercase hex
canonicalization.json: UTF-8 NFC; object keys UTF-8 byte lexicographic; compact separators; LF terminator; arrays ordered
canonicalization.null: only schema-explicit unavailable value fields; absent otherwise

data.split: occurrence order 60/20/20 DEVELOPMENT/VALIDATION/HELDOUT; floor at first two cut points; no refit after selection
data.tokens: nonempty arrays of Unicode scalar glyph strings

numeric.binary_float: IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest ties-to-even; no FMA-dependent reductions
numeric.comparison: exact binary64 after prescribed calculation; no tolerance
numeric.epsilon: none unless literal in model definition
numeric.evidence_numbers: finite scientific reals are shortest round-trip lowercase decimal strings; -0 is 0; NaN/Infinity forbidden
numeric.probability: reject nonfinite/negative; normalize by compensated sum; zero log probability is +infinity
numeric.sum: ascending scientific identity; Neumaier compensated binary64

rng.bounded: take successive u64be 8-byte blocks; if exhausted increment final counter; accept x < 2^64-(2^64 mod n), return x mod n
rng.message: ASCII G1V2-RNG NUL || root32 || u32be(namespace_utf8_len) || NFC UTF-8 namespace || u32be(counter_count) || each u64be counter
rng.ordering: all counter fields nonnegative <2^64; no execution property is a field

selection.fit: fit candidate on DEVELOPMENT only; choose on VALIDATION; selected frozen fit is evaluated on HELDOUT; no DEVELOPMENT+VALIDATION refit
selection.objective: minimum VALIDATION PM2; nonfinite is ineligible
selection.tie: within exact binary64 equality: lower complexity bits, then UTF-8 bytewise candidate_id

thresholds.one_sided: type-7 q0.95 of null absolute/effect statistic; max with literal practical floor
